title: Sealed-Bid Lots
description: Sealed-Bid Lots is a scheduling ability in the Autonomous Resource Auctioning database. Auctions compute lots with bids hidden until the round closes. Bids are committed as hashes first, then revealed; the highest revealed bid wins. It takes bid commits and produces winners. Tunable parameters: 2-phase. Guarantee: late bids are never accepted.

fields.mechanism: Bids are committed as hashes first, then revealed; the highest revealed bid wins.

function clearPrice(bids){var s=bids.slice().sort(function(a,b){return b-a;});return s[Math.floor(s.length/2)]||0;}
console.log('Clearing price: '+clearPrice([3,17,30]));

title: Continuous Clearing
description: Continuous Clearing is a scheduling ability in the Autonomous Resource Auctioning database. Clears the market continuously instead of in fixed rounds. The order book matches compatible bids and asks the moment they overlap. It takes order book and produces matches. Tunable parameters: instant. Guarantee: matches always use the best available price.

fields.mechanism: The order book matches compatible bids and asks the moment they overlap.

title: Reserve Pricing
description: Reserve Pricing is a scheduling ability in the Autonomous Resource Auctioning database. Protects sellers with a hidden minimum price per lot. Lots carry a reserve; bids below it never win and the lot rolls to the next round. It takes lot config and produces protected lots. Tunable parameters: hidden reserve. Guarantee: reserves are never revealed.

title: Bid Escrow
description: Bid Escrow is a scheduling ability in the Autonomous Resource Auctioning database. Holds winning bids in escrow until the resources are delivered. Payment locks at win time and releases on delivery confirmation or timeout refund. It takes winning bids and produces escrowed funds. Tunable parameters: timeout 1 h. Guarantee: escrow never releases without delivery proof.

title: Demand Forecasting
description: Demand Forecasting is a scheduling ability in the Autonomous Resource Auctioning database. Forecasts demand so sellers can time their lots. Historical clearing prices feed a moving average that predicts the next round's price. It takes price history and produces forecast. Tunable parameters: 7-round window. Guarantee: forecasts never promise a price.

title: Anti-Sniping
description: Anti-Sniping is a scheduling ability in the Autonomous Resource Auctioning database. Extends the round when a bid lands in the final seconds. Bids in the last 10 seconds push the close out by 30 seconds, up to 5 extensions. It takes bid stream and produces extended rounds. Tunable parameters: max 5. Guarantee: extensions never exceed the cap.

fields.mechanism: Bids in the last 10 seconds push the close out by 30 seconds, up to 5 extensions.

title: Bundle Lots

Bundle bids specify all-or-nothing; the auctioneer only clears bundles that fill completely. It takes bundle bids and produces bundle wins. Tunable parameters: all-or-nothing. Guarantee: partial bundles never clear.

title: Reputation Weighting
description: Reputation Weighting is a scheduling ability in the Autonomous Resource Auctioning database. Weights bids by bidder reputation to punish no-shows. Past delivery failures discount a bidder's effective bid by the penalty factor. It takes bidder history and produces weighted bids. Tunable parameters: penalty up to 20%. Guarantee: reputation never boosts a bid.

Guarantee: spot sales never preempt reserved.

title: Cross-Region Arbitrage
description: Cross-Region Arbitrage is a scheduling ability in the Autonomous Resource Auctioning database. Lets lots span regions with transport cost built into the price. Bids include a region; the clearing price adds the known transfer cost. It takes regional bids and produces cleared cross-region lots. Tunable parameters: cost table. Guarantee: transfer costs are never hidden.

title: Minimum Lot Sizes
description: Minimum Lot Sizes is a scheduling ability in the Autonomous Resource Auctioning database. Prevents dust lots that cost more to auction than they are worth. Lots below the minimum size are rejected at listing time with a clear reason. It takes lot listings and produces filtered lots. Tunable parameters: min 1 CPU-hour. Guarantee: rejections always state the minimum.

fields.mechanism: Lots below the minimum size are rejected at listing time with a clear reason.

title: Market Maker Bots
description: Market Maker Bots is a scheduling ability in the Autonomous Resource Auctioning database. Seeds thin markets with bot liquidity so auctions can clear. Bots post fair two-sided quotes within a spread cap; they never move the market. It takes market state and produces quotes. Tunable parameters: spread cap 5%. Guarantee: bots never trade against themselves.

fields.mechanism: Bots post fair two-sided quotes within a spread cap; they never move the market.
